scope: Fixture package for later DP1 Probe execution. This is not Probe evidence, not Kit import, not production mutation and not a conformance claim.

cases.title: Existing manual registry entries remain accepted
cases.expected_result: existing entries parse and validate without broad migration

cases.title: Valid optional ProjectionContract is accepted
cases.expected_result: projection contract fixture validates and does not affect existing entries

cases.title: Valid parent-entry PartitionContract is accepted
cases.expected_result: partition contract fixture validates with explicit parent relationship

cases.title: Unknown projection schema version fails loud
cases.expected_result: registry check rejects fixture with schema-version diagnostic

cases.title: Unknown projection field fails loud
cases.expected_result: registry check rejects unknown field without accepting partial projection state

cases.title: Missing required projection field fails loud
cases.expected_result: registry check reports the missing required field

cases.title: Dangling registered-region reference fails loud
cases.expected_result: registry check rejects dangling or inconsistent registered-region reference

cases.title: Unsupported target semantics and partition combination fails loud
cases.expected_result: registry check rejects unsupported target-semantics and partition combination

families.title: Lifecycle, acceptance and writer routing
baseline_commands: ./.venv/bin/python -m pytest -q tests/test_doc_lifecycle.py tests/test_docs_lifecycle_cli.py tests/test_docs_lifecycle_apply_cli.py tests/test_docs_lifecycle_plan_cli.py tests/test_docs_lifecycle_report_cli.py tests/test_transfer_repo_actions.py

./.venv/bin/python -m pytest -q tests/test_release_prepare_command.py tests/test_release_command_authority.py tests/test_release_prep_core.py tests/test_post_release.py tests/test_post_release_doi_closeout_atomicity.py tests/test_action_specs.py

cases.title: Immutable lifecycle plan capture
cases.expected_result: plan records source, target, base, contract, renderer, partition and ownership fingerprints

cases.title: Stale-plan rejection before Write and under lock
cases.expected_result: write and under-lock continuation reject stale target, source or context

cases.title: Atomic target or partition-preserving replacement
cases.expected_result: write is complete-target atomic or preserves declared partition boundaries

cases.title: Acceptance state creation and tamper detection
cases.expected_result: accepted state is scoped and tamper detection blocks stale or altered evidence

cases.title: Gate-set re-acceptance without renderer invocation
cases.expected_result: gate-only re-acceptance does not rerender or mutate target bytes

cases.title: Layered acceptance for registered-region projections
cases.expected_result: region acceptance does not overclaim full-document acceptance

cases.title: Administrative handoff refresh writer routing
cases.expected_result: WRT-CH-001 writes are either lifecycle-routed or classified as existing unadapted writer behavior

cases.title: Release preparation writer routing
cases.expected_result: WRT-CH-002 dry-run and write-mode behavior are bounded and not mistaken for DPA conformance

cases.title: Post-release DOI closeout writer routing
cases.expected_result: WRT-CH-003 allowed paths and cleanup are bounded before any DPA reliance

cases.title: Action-spec surfaced mutation authority
cases.expected_result: WRT-CH-004 cannot become a bypass around selected writer lifecycle routing

cases.title: Workspace initialization template writer boundary
cases.expected_result: WRT-CH-005 is contained to disposable generated target roots

cases.title: Generated successor package output boundary
cases.expected_result: WRT-CH-006 remains generator-owned and is not treated as CURRENT_HANDOFF.md target-byte writing

cases.title: Renderer map identity is explicit
cases.expected_result: approved renderer identity and interface version are resolved without fallback guessing

cases.title: Renderer rejects semantic-version mismatch
cases.expected_result: semantic-version mismatch blocks acceptance rather than silently rerendering

cases.title: Renderer deterministic repeat output
cases.expected_result: same immutable inputs produce byte-identical or explicitly declared equivalent output

cases.title: Renderer side-effect prohibition
cases.expected_result: renderer does not mutate filesystem, network, subprocess, workflow, state or evidence outside declared output

cases.title: Branch and worktree exact-ref identity
cases.expected_result: local branch, upstream and worktree state are captured before any mutable Probe

cases.title: Branch switch or rebase rejects stale plan
cases.expected_result: branch movement invalidates stale projection plan before write or evidence publication

cases.title: PR head/base and required-check identity
cases.expected_result: PR identity and required-check evidence are exact-ref scoped

cases.title: Integration-time revalidation before merge eligibility
cases.expected_result: merge eligibility cannot rely on stale Probe evidence

cases.title: Competing projection refresh conflict
cases.expected_result: competing refresh blocks or invalidates stale projection write rather than silently overwriting

cases.title: No-migration selection is explicit
cases.expected_result: no-migration is recorded as a safety result when migration evidence is insufficient

cases.title: Rollback package capture before Write
cases.expected_result: pre-write bytes, refs, source inputs and generated metadata are captured before mutation

cases.title: Exact-byte rollback after Write
cases.expected_result: post-write rollback restores exact bytes without claiming renderer reproducibility

cases.title: Exact-byte rollback after acceptance invalidates acceptance when needed
cases.expected_result: accepted state is invalidated when current renderer reproducibility is not proven

cases.title: Renderer semantic-version rollback consequence
cases.expected_result: renderer-version rollback consequence is explicit and does not preserve invalid acceptance

cases.title: Interrupted migration recovery
cases.expected_result: interrupted migration stops in recoverable state with bounded evidence

cases.title: Generated-output rollback uses command contract
cases.expected_result: generated or command-updated outputs are restored through source/generator/command contract or explicitly classified temporary repair
